page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor on an x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Acceleration is supplied by two integrated NVIDIA P4 graphics processing units offering a combined 16 GB of VRAM.

Networking capabilities for this instance type include a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. The instance lacks local NVMe SSD storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistent data handling. Additionally, zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provided with default deployment.

Featuring dual enterprise-grade NVIDIA P4 GPUs alongside dedicated compute cores, the server offers efficient hardware density for parallel processing workloads without incurring the overhead of high-end data center accelerators. The system configuration is suitable for inference tasks, video transcoding, lightweight machine learning models, and general compute workloads requiring dedicated vCPU allocation and GPU acceleration.
